title: Orange recording start declaration v1
description: What a person declares for one recording (Orange src/session/recording_start_declaration.h at cb4b65ee). Carried as local-control start_recording params.declaration or an orange_client run spec's fixed.declaration; recorded as subject_confirmation.json `declaration`. v1: no source. Cross-field rules a JSON Schema cannot express are in README.md and test_recording_start_declaration.py.

declared_by.description: The person who declares (HHMI identity form of pancakebatter host.yml). A claim; who actually sent it is the confirmation's requester.

subject_declaration.description: One declaration: a dish and/or a count; at least one key (an entry that declares nothing is refused: omit it). Undeclared fields resolve from `default`, else stay undeclared.

dish_id.description: MetaZebrobot dish id as typed. Orange: at most 256 BYTES (UTF-8), every byte > 0x20 and != 0x7f, no '/', '?' or '#'.

subject_count.description: Animals this camera records. A JSON integer token (Orange refuses 5.0).

subject_references.description: subject_references block of a start declaration v1. schema_version is this block's own version (it must equal the declaration's), NOT orange.recording_subject_reference. {"schema_version": 1} alone declares every camera undeclared (not_collected / no_dish_declared, the GUI's 'Blank all').
